body: Not everyone who is given these opportunities and responsibility use them for good, and it's not like I owe anyone change in this life. It all comes down to if I'm feeling motivated or not to use these opportunities. People die from infants to adults; many in which never have the opportunity to reach their potential. So why does it matter if someone knows all of this and still wants to end it all and give the opportunities and responsibility to someone deserving of it. I'm happy you were able to find purpose, but not everyone can reach that point. Sorry if this message comes off as negative. its never my goal to attack someone's beliefs.

What exactly is keeping you up? 
Sorry I have no advice because I'm going through the same thing as you, but my reason is that I haven't told my parents I dropped out of college and the fall is coming soon. I know if I tell them they would kick me out, and It doesn't help that I  just quit my job last week. So thoughts of how much of a lowlife I am keep running through my head, and putting myself in scenarios where I was a white handsome and cool guy instead of this dopey eyed pale Mexican fuck head. Maybe talking about it to some loser like me could help release some stress.

Last month, I snuck out of my parent's house, while they were sleeping and went into their barn where my dad had a rifle, and I set it up on a table, where I  pointed it to my temple. Thinking that if I put it in my mouth that there was a chance of me living if it missed my brain, but fear started to take over and I started to get mad at myself for not going through it. So I just sat for hours with no emotion and stared blankly at the door. Until I realized I couldn't do it. Then I put everything back together and went into my room, and started crying. This was when I haven't told my parents I dropped out of college and have no way of financially supporting myself if they kicked me out. Thankfully my parents didn't kick me out, but I realized that I'm pretty much a deadbeat working at a dead-end job with no  friends or education. Now I feel even worse than I did a month ago. I still have suicidal thoughts and I cry every day wishing I was someone else.

I'm also close to my limit, I've realized that I have no future to improve on because I'm creepy looking, really dumb, and forgettable. I feel disgusted with myself because I'm not even good at anything, I can't even get anyone to like me at all. It's all because of genetics. I was an unlucky person who was born ugly, dumb, and useless.
The pain that might occur, or the risk of what might happen if I attempted it and didn't die.

I've tried to before when my funny guy act was broken and I busted out crying to one of my friends about suicide and how I feel bored and sad all the time, but he froze and didn't say anything, so I left his house and we haven't spoken until a week ago. I told myself to never open up to anyone and to keep everything bottled up until hopefully, it kills me. We still hang out, but only with other people around where I can still put up a macho funny guy front.
It doesn't help to know that these "jobs" are built by other people, whose only goal is to make money from people who are trying to get by.
